exam_questions.question_text: مثال (18): اذا كان z = cos 2x + i sin 2x فأثبت ان 2 / (1 + z) = 1 - i tan x
exam_questions.full_model_solution: L.H.S = 2 / (1 + z) = 2 / (1 + cos 2x + i sin 2x). Using half-angle identities: 1 + cos 2x = 2 cos² x and sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x. Substituting: 2 / (2 cos² x + 2i sin x cos x) = 2 / [2 cos x (cos x + i sin x)] = 1 / [cos x (cos x + i sin x)]. Multiplying by the conjugate (cos x - i sin x) or using (cos x + i sin x)^-1 = cos x - i sin x: = (cos x - i sin x) / cos x = cos x / cos x - i (sin x / cos x) = 1 - i tan x = R.H.S

exam_questions.question_text: مثال (19): 2019 الدور (2) اذا كان z = cos θ + i sin θ اثبت ان (1 + z_bar)z = 1 + z
exam_questions.full_model_solution: L.H.S = (1 + z̄)z. Since z = cos θ + i sin θ, then z̄ = cos θ - i sin θ. (1 + cos θ - i sin θ)(cos θ + i sin θ). Grouping terms: [(1 + cos θ) - i sin θ] * (cos θ + i sin θ) = (1 + cos θ)(cos θ + i sin θ) - i sin θ(cos θ + i sin θ) = cos θ + i sin θ + cos² θ + i sin θ cos θ - i sin θ cos θ - i² sin² θ = (cos θ + i sin θ) + (cos² θ + sin² θ) = z + 1 = R.H.S
